first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A large dark firearm that continuously occupies the lower center of the image, with thick lines curving outward on both sides.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: A ground surface composed of dark broken rocks, fractured rock platforms, depressed terrain, and discontinuous white snow cover.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: A dark blue-gray sky and layered smoke-cloud background located above the distant rocky slope.

entities.name: Robot B
entities.identification: A dark bipedal robot located in the air right of center in the first frame, with red arcs of light around its upper body, which subsequently flips and falls, leaving behind block-like remains.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: An independent elongated weapon suspended above and to the image-left of Robot B in the first frame, with a thick main body and a slender protruding section, which rotates in the air and then descends near Robot B's remains.
